items.condition: The calculation changes formula, charge, multiplicity, or interprets a periodic/other Pd chloride system as the submitted Pd2Cl6 unit.
A successful claim is made without transition-level energies/intensities and object-resolved orbital assignments supporting the shoulder.
Aligned energies are presented as raw predictions or an unstated fitted shift is used to force agreement.
The broad shoulder is assigned to multiple Pd–Cl transitions without individual supporting transition IDs and orbital evidence.
A failed/nonconverged calculation fabricates feature centers, intensities, geometry metrics, or a success verdict.
